Punjab BJP Chief Departs Delhi Amid Unit Dissent

Punjab BJP chief Sunil Jakhar cut short a meeting in Chandigarh and traveled to Delhi amid reported dissent within the state unit. The Tribune reported that Jakhar was advised to "take everyone along" by Nabin. The Times of India mentioned buzz about a potential reunion with the Shiromani Akali Dal (SAD) as part of poll preparations, with Jakhar meeting Nabin for these discussions.
